The business was founded on a commitment to old-fashioned craftsmanship as an alternative to mass-produced wood products.
Customers include woodworkers, cabinet makers, and DIY enthusiasts seeking raw hardwood materials, live-edge slabs, and quality cabinet hardware.
The business serves both individual buyers and trade customers through direct orders and an online gallery.
By avoiding computerized machinery, the shop ensures each piece reflects individual attention and traditional joinery methods.
